themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can perform complex research tasks autonomously, interact with tools, and manage workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focusing on AI tools that help developers write, review, and debug code, including security implications.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Research and discussions about AI-generated personas or data that mimic human users for testing or analysis.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles that highlight or review specific AI-powered platforms and software designed to aid research processes.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Content that explores how AI is used in the design process, from generating concepts to refining user interfaces.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, data, or research findings into digestible summaries.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Discussions on using AI to analyze or assist in qualitative research methods, such as interviews or open-ended feedback.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Content related to the research, development, and impact of AI-powered chatbots, including their limitations and ethical considerations.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Articles discussing the use of AI to automate software testing processes, ensuring better quality and efficiency.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Research and analysis on how AI is changing job roles, hiring practices, and the skills required in the modern workforce.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
